payload.name: EnumerateAdditionalItemsViaCategorySearches
payload.description: When answering enumeration questions about read/watched/played/consumed items, after an initial search returns some items, run additional searches for generic category descriptions before finalizing.
content: If the question asks for a list or enumeration of items a person has read, watched, played, or consumed, do not finalize the answer after one search even if it returns some concrete items.

Run additional hybrid or keyword searches pairing the activity with generic category descriptors likely present in memories (e.g., 'non-fiction', 'series', 'fantasy', 'personal development', 'mystery') and inspect both event and preference memories for items described by category.
Aggregate all distinct named or clearly described items from all searches before composing the answer; if only one search was performed, treat the list as potentially incomplete.

solves: When a question asks for an enumeration of items a person has read/watched/played/consumed, an initial search may return some named items yet miss memories that describe additional items by category. The diagnosed failure was stopping after one retrieval and omitting category-described books. Applies to any future list/enumeration query where relevant memories may describe items generically; run supplementary searches before answering.
